name: The Tempest's Weapons
summary: An old shaman in the Alterac Mountains may know how to use the Eye of the Tempest. You bring him the artifact so he can craft with its storm magic.

sections.title: An Old Shaman
sections.body: After the battle with the elementals, you bring the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in the Alterac Mountains. He has an eye for storm elemental magic and sees power in the artifact. Bath'rah says he has not worked with anything like it in a long time, and urges you to take good care of it.

faq.answer: Bath'rah the Windwatcher is an old shaman in the Alterac Mountains with an eye for storm elemental magic.

faq.q: What is the Eye of the Tempest?
faq.answer: The Eye of the Tempest is a powerful artifact associated with storm elemental magic.

faq.q: Why bring the Eye to Bath'rah?
faq.answer: Bath'rah may be able to craft something with the Eye of the Tempest because he understands storm elemental magic.

faq.q: What does Bath'rah say about the artifact?
faq.answer: Bath'rah calls the Eye of the Tempest powerful and says he has not crafted with anything like it in a long time.

angles.text: As a shaman, you bring a powerful artifact of storm elemental magic to Bath'rah, an old shaman with an eye for that magic.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Tempest's Weapons
